title: Kim Kardashian’s Minimalist Beats Speaker Now Available for Just $85 Online
summary: The Kim Kardashian x Beats Pill collaboration is down to its lowest price yet on Amazon.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Kim Kardashian and Beats extended their partnership in 2024 with the release of the Beats Pill wireless speaker , reworked in a very Kardashian-inspired minimalist light gray and dark gray colorway.

Now, two years later, Amazon is clearing out the Kim Kardashian x Beats Pill during Prime Big Deal Days , dropping the Bluetooth speaker down to its lowest price ever.

GREAT GIFT IDEA

Beats Pill x Kim Kardashian Wireless Bluetooth Speaker

$85 $149.95 43% off

Buy Now On Amazon

Originally $149+ when it was first released, you can get the collaborative speaker on sale for just $85 right now — a 43% discount and the lowest price ever.

Compatible with Android and iOS, the new Beats Pill comes redesigned with new hardware and capabilities including up to 24 hours of battery life and USB-C charging (you can also use the unit as a portable charger for your phone or tablet).

The speaker is also rated IP67 to be dust- and water-resistant, and the Pill pairs easily over Bluetooth, compatible with laptops , cell phones and other Pill speakers. The Beats Pill features Amplify Mode, which can be accessed by synching two speakers together, but one speaker is plenty loud on its own, delivering room-filling sound and surprisingly deep, full bass.

“I’m excited to be back with my Beats family and to bring two new colors to an iconic product,” said Kardashian, when the speaker first came out. “Music is a big part of my everyday life, from morning gym sessions to creative brainstorms, and the Beats Pill makes it that much more beautiful.”

Reviewers, meantime, love this special-edition speaker, giving it a 4.7-star rating (out of five) from more than a thousand verified shoppers. Almost 90% of reviewers give the Kardashian Beats speaker a full, five-star review.

While it’s not clear whether the reality star’s partnership with Beats will continue, one thing is sure: this chic audio collaboration was already a must-have at its original $150 price point — at $85, it’s a certified steal.

The new deal comes ahead of the holiday shopping season, where music fans and Kardashian fans alike will no doubt be pleased to see this under the tree. Get the Kim Kardashian x Beats Pill Speaker deal here .
